scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && node --check scripts/quick-stills.mjs && python3 -m py_compile scripts/make-audio.py
scripts.render:preview: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts AdvertioCargoPreview out/preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --concurrency=2
scripts.render:final: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts AdvertioCargoFinal out/final.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=2
